From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: token volumes & pricing targets

Hi Elena -

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align with your finance team:

1) Volume we discussed (monthly):
   - Estimated MAUs: 120k active users
   - Avg requests per user/day (pilot): 0.8
   - Avg tokens per request: 250 tokens
   => Rough baseline: 120,000 * 0.8 * 30 * 250 ≈ 720M tokens / month

2) Target unit economics you mentioned: $/1M tokens in the range of $600–$900 (goal ~$700/1M).

3) Our typical pilot offer (example):
   - Pilot term: 90 days
   - Included tokens: 250M tokens / month (burst to 500M)
   - Targeted unit price (pilot): $800 / 1M tokens
   - Optional scaling tiers and committed discount for annual.

Next asks to move forward:
- Can you confirm who the economic buyer is for this project (name & title)?
- Is Elena the budget owner for the pilot, and does procurement/finance need a formal SOW or PO to sign?
- Will Tom Hughes (CFO) need to sign off on unit economics? If so, happy to set up a 30-min call with him + finance to walk the model.

I attached a one-pager with the pricing bands and a quick MPU estimate for your numbers. If you prefer, I can drop a line itemized quote for procurement to review.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Wed or Thu next week to review pricing with your finance owner. What time looks best?

Thanks -
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0139

Attachment: marketpulse-mpu-estimates.xlsx
